name: bauify
description: Deterministic, evidence-first code analysis that produces facts, findings, and Archify architecture IR.

scripts.e2e:archify: node bin/analyze.mjs run ../archify/archify --out out/archify --json && node ../archify/archify/bin/archify.mjs deliver architecture out/archify/repo.architecture.json out/archify/repo.html --quality standard --repo-root ../archify --json
scripts.e2e:ai-voice: node bin/analyze.mjs run "$BAUIFY_AI_VOICE_ROOT" --language py --out out/ai-voice --json && node ../archify/archify/bin/archify.mjs deliver architecture out/ai-voice/repo.architecture.json out/ai-voice/repo.html --quality standard --repo-root "$BAUIFY_AI_VOICE_ROOT" --json
